# ShramkoGSFPV

> Open-source (MIT) browser FPV drone simulator for 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes. Fly any public SuperSplat scan with a quadcopter model (4 motors, mixer, rate PID, Betaflight/Actual/KISS/Raceflight rate curves), swept voxel collision with real crashes, and your EdgeTX radio over WebHID, a gamepad or touch sticks. WebGPU + PlayCanvas. Author: Andrii Shramko. Live at https://gsfpv.flyreelstudio.eu (alpha, September 2026).

Key facts (measured, see evidence/latest.json):
- Rate curves match compiled Betaflight 4.5.1 at 1880 points with 0 deg/s error.
- 0 wall pass-throughs in 200,000 straight passes at 5-34 m/s (1 ms swept test vs an independent oracle).
- The whole flight is deterministic: the SHA-256 of the trace is identical in Node and Chrome and across 30/60/144/240 Hz frame splits; replays are recomputed from stick inputs only.
- Scenes load in the visitor's browser straight from the public SuperSplat CDN; the server never contacts SuperSplat.
- Default craft: BetaFPV Pavo20 Pro class 2.2-inch cinewhoop; every preset number is labelled manufacturer / measured / estimate.
- Radio support has been tested with a simulated EdgeTX radio; a real radio has not been tested yet.
